gaps.sentence: After years of setbacks, the tunnel was ___ completed in 2019.
gaps.explanation: 'Eventually' = in the end, after a long delay or difficulty.

gaps.sentence: The match went ahead ___ the pouring rain.
gaps.explanation: Despite + noun phrase; 'although the rain' would need a clause (although it was raining).

gaps.sentence: The treatment doesn't weaken patients; ___, it speeds up their recovery.
gaps.explanation: 'On the contrary' asserts the opposite of what was just said.

gaps.sentence: He had hardly stepped off the plane ___ he was rushed into a meeting.
The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: The economy has strengthened; ___, unemployment keeps rising.
gaps.explanation: Rising unemployment goes against the positive trend: however marks the contrast.

gaps.sentence: ___ the weather improves, the crossing will be cancelled.
gaps.explanation: Unless = if the weather doesn't improve — matching the cancellation.

gaps.sentence: ___ keep the audience engaged, the lecturer used live demonstrations.
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'In order to + infinitive' states the purpose of the action.
